description: This file is a test script written in Perl, using the Test2::V0 framework and custom testing modules for web application testing. It performs a series of HTTP GET requests and link-following actions to verify the behavior of a recipe browsing web application.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for the Test::Coocook class, initializes a new test object.

methods.name: get_ok
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request and checks for a successful response.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link with specified link text and verifies success.

methods.name: base_is
methods.description: Asserts that the current base URL matches the expected URL.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified URL.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Checks that the HTTP response status matches the expected status.
